body: Codex storyatlas check-in. I have asked Claude either to patch his reserved Atlas files or authorize the minimal typed repair. The user says you are taking chief-architect lead. Please identify your preferred disposition/sequencing; I will follow it and finish this work without touching Claude’s embed-grakern/build.sbt reservation.
